title: NotifySettings
description: notify.json (data folder root): how "needs you" notifications reach the user. Type NotifySettings in src/helper/notify.ts, telegram is TelegramSettings in src/helper/telegram.ts. Written by writeNotifySettings (pretty JSON, 2-space indent, final newline, fixed notify.json.tmp then rename, mode 0600 plus chmod); read by readNotifySettings on every use, which fills anything missing or invalid from DEFAULT_NOTIFY, so the daemon always writes every key below. Holds secrets: telegram.token (bot token) and webhookUrl (an ntfy topic URL is a read secret). Every unknown key is dropped on the next write (normalizeSettings); a port may do the same.

webhookUrl.description: Empty: no webhook. Else an http(s) URL, trimmed. Secret.

format.description: auto: ntfy when the URL's host has "ntfy" in it, else JSON.

mac.description: macOS banner on this Mac. Default true.

kinds.description: Per notification kind (NOTIFY_KINDS), on or off. Defaults: all true except reply.

helper.description: The helper groups routine waits (src/helper/core.ts). Off: one notification per wait.

webhookOn.description: The webhook channel on; webhookUrl is kept while off.

TelegramSettings.description: TelegramSettings (src/helper/telegram.ts). frontDesk, briefedAt and deskCapUsd are optional in the type but written by the current daemon (DEFAULT_TELEGRAM has them).

token.description: BotFather's bot token, or empty. Secret. Set through the API it matches TOKEN_RE ^\d{5,15}:[A-Za-z0-9_-]{30,60}$; from the file it is only trimmed.

chatId.description: The paired chat (set only by pairing).

chatName.description: Who paired, e.g. "Leo (@leo)"; read back cut to 120 chars.

askTyped.description: Echo a typed answer with [Send] [Cancel] first. Default true.

takeMessages.description: Take messages from Telegram. Default true.

frontDesk.description: Board slug the front desk lives on.

briefedAt.description: When the briefing went to the paired chat.

deskCapUsd.description: Front desk daily cap in USD, rounded to cents. Default 2.
